text: Refunds are available within 30 days of purchase. The customer must provide an order number. Approved refunds are returned to the original payment method.
Standard shipping usually takes 3 to 5 business days. Express shipping usually takes 1 to 2 business days. Delivery times are estimates and may vary by location.
Products include a 12-month limited warranty from the purchase date. The warranty covers manufacturing defects and excludes accidental damage.
Customer support is available Monday through Friday, 9 AM to 5 PM local time. Users can contact support using the help form in their account.
